greeting.text: What can I do for you?

click.text: Welcome in, love. Mind the step, and the cheese.
Everything on the shelf is for sale. Some of it even wants to be.
Have a look through the stock. I keep it honest, mostly.
Anything catch your eye? Besides the smell of the Brie?

advance.text: There, that's the days gone. The shelves look older already.
Time flies when you're watching stock spoil.
All done. The Brie's delighted. Nobody else is.
Another stretch behind us, and not one item sold. Lovely.

worthless.text: That concert's been and gone, love. Those passes are kindling now.
Well, those tickets won't be getting anyone through any door.
The music's over, and so is the value of those passes.

vest.text: The plus five is mostly confidence, love.
It's very nimble. Left the last owner without warning.
Loses a little every day. Don't we all?

brie.text: The only thing in this inn improving with age. I've checked.
The older it gets, the more it's worth. I've asked it for advice.
Leave it long enough and it'll be running the place.

elixir.text: One sip and you'll feel quick as a mongoose. Bitten, too, I shouldn't wonder.
Drink it soon, love. It's past caring, but you shouldn't be.
Tastes like regret with a hint of honey.

maul.text: Never sold it, never will. It won't let me.
Quality eighty, every single day. I find that a bit smug.
Mind your fingers. And your eyebrows.

ticket.text: The closer the show, the dearer it gets. Then it's a bookmark.
Best seats in the house, until about one minute after the encore.
Nobody's told me who's playing. Nobody can pronounce it.

cake.text: Twice as quick to spoil, and it was never that good to start with.
Conjured this morning. Regretted by noon.
It's mostly sparkle, love. There's no cake to speak of.
